question: How did the current Pine v8 Core Recall K1-to-K2 rule perform on OKX BTCUSDT.P 1h over the latest six-month window, and what observable setup/path conditions distinguish profitable, losing, and unresolved trades?

owner_authorization.scope: read and score prices at or after the repository holdout boundary for this exact backtest
owner_authorization.verbatim: 批准读取 2026-05-04 之后的价格

window.unresolved_tail_policy: keep signals in the ledger but exclude paths without a barrier hit or all 12 future bars from scored metrics

source.primary: official OKX public history-candles endpoint, confirmed 1H rows only

signal.dedupe: highest Pine K1-quality per K2, earliest accepted K2 per remembered K1, global six-entry-bar cooldown, long priority only on same entry bar

execution.entry: open of the bar immediately after confirmed K2
execution.stop: exact completed K2 low for long and K2 high for short
execution.timeout_exit: close of the twelfth entry-path bar

matched_control.insufficient_exact_stratum_policy: keep the candidate in primary metrics, do not relax matching, mark it unmatched, and exclude only that pair from the paired test

causal_flags.edge_gap_2_7_8: gap is 2, 7, or 8 rather than central 3-6
causal_flags.k1_close_below_owner_strict: K1 directional close location is below 0.85
causal_flags.k1_ma_colour_misaligned: K1 HL2 is on the opposite side of SMA40
causal_flags.k2_wick_below_owner_strict: K2 rejection wick share is below 0.60
causal_flags.k2_rejection_below_owner_strict: K2 directional rejection location is below 0.65
causal_flags.k2_close_back_below_owner_strict: K2 close-back depth is below 0.25 ATR
causal_flags.k2_touch_outside_owner_strict: K2 touch depth is outside 0.10-1.00 ATR
causal_flags.risk_outside_owner_strict: next-open stop distance is outside 0.25-2.00 ATR
causal_flags.path_close_distance_large: absolute K2-to-K1 close distance exceeds 0.75 K1 ATR
causal_flags.path_wrong_sma40_close: an intermediate close crossed to the wrong SMA40 side
causal_flags.path_ma_colour_not_continuous: intermediate MA-side colour share is below 1.00
causal_flags.oscillator_state_misaligned: owner oscillator sequence is not fully aligned
causal_flags.market_structure_misaligned: confirmed 10/10 market-break state is not aligned

diagnostics.interpretation: causal flags are descriptive pre-entry conditions; post-entry classes describe the realized path. Neither is a causal estimate or a tuned filter.

evaluation.primary_unit: each Pine signal independently, including overlapping opportunities
evaluation.portfolio_sensitivity: one position at a time; later signals are skipped until the active trade exits
evaluation.headline_success: net return after the frozen 0.2% round-trip cost is greater than zero
evaluation.paired_test: one-sided deterministic sign-flip test of candidate net return minus its three-control mean
evaluation.auc: not applicable; this is a deterministic threshold rule and no score-ranked trading arm is evaluated
evaluation.top_decile: not applicable; no score threshold or rank is selected on this holdout
